title: [spec-gap][R-02AT-020] CCP join FSM unwired in all stacks; ACQUIRING->SYNCED skips DAO slot request; REJOINING unreachable (spec 02a-tdma.md:61-63)
description: Spec 02a-tdma.md:61-63 join FSM: ACQUIRING requires a valid beacon (signature verified, stratum >= current, ts >= epoch_floor) which triggers adopt SFN/time and send DAO with slot request; SYNCED = DAO-ACK received. Classification: divergent + unwired. (1) The FSM has zero production callers in every stack: C lichen_ccp_fsm_event (lichen/subsys/lichen/link/tdma.c:191-261) is called only from lichen/tests/tdma_guard_budget/main.c:164,184,194 and lichen/tests/desync_fsm/main.c:228,230,236; python timing/tdma_fsm.py on_event (:18-43) only from python/tests/timing/test_tdma_fsm.py:20-21; rust gateway tdma_fsm.rs on_event (:42-55) only from its own tests; rust core CcpFSM (lichen-core/src/desync.rs:294-339) test-only. The live C RX path feeds only the 14.7 DesyncFSM (lichen_l2_rx.c:256-263); see existing bead project-LICHEN-worker6-d7hg for that wiring remainder. (2) Every FSM jumps ACQUIRING->SYNCED directly on VALID_BEACON (C tdma.c:204-209; python tdma_fsm.py:26-27; rust tdma_fsm.rs:45); no state sends the spec's DAO-with-slot-request, and REJOINING is exit-only (C tdma.c:251-257 exits on DAO_ACK_SLOT; python tdma_fsm.py:42-43; rust tdma_fsm.rs:52) so it is unreachable. (3) The admission predicates exist but are not composed into the FSM: ts>=epoch_floor C lichen_epoch_floor_accepts (time_sync.c:574-579) / rust lichen-link/src/epoch_floor.rs:70; stratum>=current python timing/stratum.py should_adopt_time :303-325 (deprecated scalar) and time_sync.py:279-306,410-416. Suggested placement: drive the CCP FSM from real beacon events (C: lichen_l2_rx.c / l2 core; rust: lichen-node rpl_stack; python: node RX loop), insert a DAO slot-request state between beacon adoption and SYNCED consuming DAO-ACK slot assignment, and compose signature+stratum+epoch_floor gates at the ACQUIRING transition. From spec-coverage sweep 2026-09-09 (docs/spec-coverage/02a-tdma.md R-02AT-019/020).
